items.title: Quantum Technology Marketing Group (Reading, UK)
items.summary: Leak-site listing discovered September 22, 2026; attackers estimate initial intrusion around August 13.

items.title: Beer distributor, Rochester, NY
items.summary: Claim posted September 22, 2026 alleging theft of about 165 GB of company data.

items.title: IDScan cloud platform
items.summary: IDScan disclosed on September 4 possible unauthorized access to identity data stored in customer accounts on its cloud platform; attribution to a ransomware group not confirmed.

items.title: Rhysida leak-site activity
items.summary: Rhysida has close to 300 named victims tracked as of September 1, 2026, 54 of them posted in the past twelve months.

ransomware.note: Named-victim reporting was thin this cycle; two of the items are leak-site claims the victims have not yet confirmed.

items.title: Azure East US regional failure takes down AI chatbots
items.summary: A September 3 regional failure in Azure East US knocked ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Grok offline in the same ~90-minute window, with knock-on effects for SaaS apps hosted in the region.

items.title: Concentration risk: shared cloud regions
items.summary: Commentary on the Azure incident notes that SaaS vendors clustered in the same few regions fail together, whichever application vendors a customer picks.

outage.note: No new major hyperscaler outage in the past two weeks. As of mid-September, Google Cloud, Azure, Cloudflare and GitHub reported normal operations.

items.title: CISA adds seven exploited flaws to KEV
items.summary: September 2 additions include Sangoma Switchvox SQLi (CVE-2026-9586), Starlette request smuggling (CVE-2026-48710) and CVE-2026-49869.

items.title: CVE-2026-49869 used for reverse shells and crypto miners
items.summary: Attackers likely exploited the flaw from late June to open reverse shells, map Docker environments, deploy crypto miners and harvest data.

items.title: Chromium V8 type confusion (CVE-2026-85046) added to KEV
items.summary: CISA added an actively exploited Chrome V8 type-confusion bug on September 4, flagging significant risk to the federal enterprise.

items.title: Two Linux kernel flaws added to KEV
items.summary: On September 18, CISA added a race condition (CVE-2025-39964) and an out-of-bounds write (CVE-2026-53266) in the Linux kernel.

items.title: Windows zero-day exploited while EPSS scored it under 1%
items.summary: One of two Windows zero-days added to KEV this month was already being exploited while its EPSS score sat below one percent, which shows the limits of EPSS-only patch prioritization.

items.title: M 6.5 near Nikolski, Alaska (Aleutians)
items.summary: Offshore quake 169 km W of Nikolski on September 17; tsunami flag set, USGS PAGER alert green.

items.title: M 6.4 near Kainantu, Papua New Guinea
items.summary: Quake 49 km NNE of Kainantu on September 20; no tsunami, USGS PAGER alert green.

items.title: 2026 natural-event tally passes 7,800
items.summary: NASA EONET logged 7,821 natural events in 2026 as of September 22: 7,310 wildfires, 401 floods and 65 severe storms.

physical.note: Searches found no named hurricane, typhoon or flood event from September. Check NHC/JTWC directly during peak tropical season.
